infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RSL Cards uses your location to discover nearby sports card shows, conventions, and local dealer trade events.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RSL Cards uses the camera to scan raw and graded sports cards, barcodes, and slabs to instantly identify player details, look up real-time pricing comps, and add cards to your inventory.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RSL Cards accesses your photo library to let you upload sports card photos for AI valuation, customize your dealer profile avatar, and attach transaction receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: RSL Cards needs permission to save generated card comps, deal receipts, and invoices to your photo library.
